A1_harness_validity.requirement: Harness reproduces C=23 and ranks 11/11/18 under dense-only.

A2_target_chunks.requirement: Chunk 11 is in d02's final context and chunk 27 is in d09's.

gained_facts: d02: softmax over the scaled dot products
d02: scaling by the square root of the key dimension

A3_no_facts_lost.requirement: No fact that is regex-present at baseline top-10 becomes absent (all 26 facts).

A4_token_projection.method: Least-squares fit of prompt_tokens against total chunk characters on the 23 single-call A3/B3 doc prompts (calls==1, status 200, not refused): slope 0.1364 tokens/char, intercept (overhead) 1223.5 tokens, residual std 169.2, max abs residual 364.7. Replaces the ruling's estimates (O ~270, ~190/chunk). Projection is the mean over the 12 doc questions of the fitted values on the reranked top-10 contexts. Reranked context chars (9491-9953) against the fit's x-range (8932-9915): the largest exceeds the range by 38 chars (0.4%, about 5 tokens at the fitted slope), a negligible extrapolation; the 457-token margin to the limit dwarfs both it and the max residual (365).
A4_token_projection.requirement: Projected mean prompt tokens <= 3000, computed on the actual new prompts.

A5_memory_load.requirement: MEM <= 480 MB and L1 zero 5xx/OOM at concurrency 10 under 512 MB with the model loaded (free load subset).

A6_latency.early_signal: Design-check run (cold, n=12): p50 1427 ms, p95 4442 ms. Follow-up probe (warm-up + 3 rounds x 12, n=36): p50 4071 ms, p95 4615 ms. Investigated the same evening: a second probe timing encode/infer separately (default vs tuned ORT session) showed the default session at 320-432 ms per 25-pair batch with encode ~2 ms. The slow runs were transient laptop contention (cause unidentified; the machine was fairly idle at re-test). Restricting ORT to 4 threads made it 5-8x slower and is rejected. Steady-state expectation ~350 ms; the formal A6 is measured post-implementation.
A6_latency.requirement: Rerank p95 <= 3 s (unconstrained profile); also record p50 and the render-like profile (rerank latency inside the 512 MB-constrained container).

admissibility.note: All of A1-A6 must hold before any provider run. A1-A4 measured 2026-11-13 by evaluation/p73_design_check.py (zero provider calls); A5/A6 are measured after implementation, before any provider run (they cannot exist before the code does).

budget_protocol.config_A4_B4: Shipped service path, cache off, guardrails default, repair retry as shipped, design P with the selected model.
budget_protocol.counting: Successful calls only; the ledger is the authority; every provider-calling script writes its own rows. CI release-smoke runs count (1 each): batch pushes.
budget_protocol.ordering: Pass/fail only on the pre-registered gates; B4 starts only after A4 is recorded; nothing is changed between them.
budget_protocol.plan: A4 on UTC day 1 (<= 28 incl. repairs), B4 on UTC day 2 (<= 28), then the R1 re-check on day 2 (on-arm, 1 repeat, 15 requests). Worst-case total 71 + 2 release-smoke calls (pre-run push + close-out push) = 73 <= 80. Per-day worst case: day 1 = 28 (A4) + 1 (pre-run push smoke) = 29; day 2 = 28 (B4) + 15 (R1) + 1 (close-out push smoke, if same day) = 44; both <= 60.
budget_protocol.repair_rule: Only 503 casualties re-run, <= 5 repair rounds per run, still-503 = not measured. No other re-rolls.

E2.measurement_point: The DENSE candidate stage against the FAISS reference (its purpose is embedding parity; expected to stay 1.000). Also report, ungated, the overlap of the final reranked context with the reference.

E3.measurement_point: The FINAL context. Report C' beside it. C' >= 25 is not E3; it is the admissibility gate A2/A3.

S1.gate: >= 22/26 raw in BOTH runs A4 and B4

S2.reporting: Abstained/measured with n measured. 503 = not measured (P7.2 precedent). If fewer than 3 absent questions are measured, S2 is 'not assessable', never 'met'.

gates.note: Nothing moves silently. gates.json is not edited; these rulings live here and in DECISIONS.md.

labels: A, B, A2, B2, A3, B3, A4, B4 stay in every table; P7.3 rows carry 'retrieval unfrozen'; the tuned-on-the-same-questions disclosure appears everywhere (post-hoc iteration, tuned on the evaluation questions; held-out check is Project 9).
manager_clarifications: A5/A6 are measured after implementation, before any provider run; they cannot be measured before the code exists. Failure of either means no provider runs and Project 7 closes.
Push via Sol's established Session-1 scheduled-task route (verified in P7.1/P7.2); Hamza only if that route fails. The ruling's '[H1] push' label is Claude's assumption, not a new Hamza action.
'Smallest that passes' is judged by measured ONNX download size, not list order.
'Render-like profile' in A6 means rerank latency measured inside the 512 MB-constrained container.
The reranker adapter is an OnnxRuntime adapter (not a FastEmbed adapter), because the pinned fastembed lacks the class; this is the ruling's fallback branch, not a design change.
The ONNX artifact is model_quantized.onnx (int8), the standard Xenova deployment artifact.

The S5 projection (A4) is the mean over the 12 doc questions of the fitted values on the reranked contexts. The harness S5 denominator also includes non-refused absent rows (503s at 0 tokens lower it), so the projection is conservative.
